"I just wanted to let it go, because if I would hold it inside. I wouldn't be able to say a word. I would just go not really nice over there." Rybakina's composure proved a sharp contrast as she absorbed Sabalenka's heavy hitting before stepping forward to dictate, eventually pulling away in the deciding set to win her third Grand Slam title and first at Flushing Meadows. "She played really aggressive, great tennis. She was simply a better player today than me," Sabalenka said of her opponent. Rybakina had already dethroned her from the top of the rankings before the final, ending Sabalenka's 99-week reign at world number one. "Let's see if Elena can beat me in that," Sabalenka said with a laugh. "She continue to play like that, then yeah, I'm in trouble." Sabalenka also missed the chance to reward the crowd that had rallied behind her. Having faced an American opponent in each of her previous three U.S. Open finals, she at last found Arthur Ashe Stadium firmly behind her. "I felt like, 'Oh, my God, I feel American over there'," she said. "I just wish I could win it and feel the support even more. Yeah, not this year." The defeat also ended Sabalenka's 20-match winning streak at Flushing Meadows and denied her the chance to join Serena Williams and Chris Evert as the only women in the professional era to win three straight U.S. Open titles.

item.title: Nationals blow another lead, then beat Angels
item.description: Harry Ford drove in the winning run with an infield grounder and the Nationals survived another blown save to beat the Los Angeles Angels 6-5 in Washington on Saturday.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: Harry Ford drove in the winning run with an infield grounder and the Nationals survived another blown save to beat the Los Angeles Angels 6-5 in Washington on Saturday. With one out, Daylen Lile was intentionally walked by Jose Fermin (4-3). Runners CJ Abrams and Lile executed a double steal and, with the infield in, shortstop Zach Neto booted Ford's grounder and Abrams scored the winning run. Jack Sinclair (1-0) pitched 1 1/3 inning for the win. Washington tied it 5-5 against Ben Joyce in the ninth. After Jose Tena walked, James Wood struck out but Tena was running on the pitch and went to third when catcher Moises Ballesteros's throw went into center. Andres Chaparro lined a single to center to score Tena with the tying tun. Los Angeles trailed 4-0 entering the eighth. Mike Trout walked against Brad Lord with two outs and pinch hitter Wade Meckler doubled to right, scoring Trout. Vaughn Grissom homered to left and the Angels were within 4-3. Oswald Peraza walked against Will Dion leading off the ninth. Denzer Guzman doubled down the left-field line to score Peraza with the tying run, went to third on a wild pitch and scored the go-ahead run on Ballesteros sacrifice fly. The Nationals added to their Major League record with their 39th blown save of the season. Keibert Ruiz had three hits for Washington. The Nationals took a 1-0 lead in the first when Abimelec Ortiz doubled with one out and scored on a two-out double by Abrams. In the Washington second, Ruiz doubled with one out. Jacob Young singled with two outs and Ruiz was initially called out at home, but the call was overturned after Washington challenged. Wood singled Young to third and stole second. Ortiz then lined a single to right scoring both runners to make it 4-0. Washington starter Andrew Alvarez tossed seven scoreless innings and did not allow a hit until Jose Siri doubled with one out in the sixth. He set new career highs in innings pitched and strikeouts (eight) while walking four Los Angeles starter Walbert Urena gave up four runs on nine hits over six innings. He struck out seven and walked two while throwing 101 pitches. --Field Level Media

item.title: Marlins' bullpen helps end Dodgers' 8-game winning streak
item.description: Graham Pauley slugged a two-run homer and Otto Lopez smacked a go-ahead RBI single in a three-run second inning as the host Miami Marlins defeated the Los Angeles Dodgers 4-3 on Saturday afternoon.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: Graham Pauley slugged a two-run homer and Otto Lopez smacked a go-ahead RBI single in a three-run second inning as the host Miami Marlins defeated the Los Angeles Dodgers 4-3 on Saturday afternoon. Miami's bullpen allowed just two hits and one run in 5 1/3 innings. Lopez, who is batting .310, is 6-for-7 so far in the first two games of this series. He started Saturday in second place, behind Phillies infielder Luis Arraez, in the battle for the National League batting title. Arraez started the day batting .318. The Dodgers (90-58) had their eight-game win streak broken. Miami (73-76) snapped a four-game losing skid. The Marlins are just 2-7 over their past nine games. Max Muncy and Mookie Betts -- each with a solo homer -- led Los Angeles' offense. Muncy has 28 dingers this season. Betts has 20. Dodgers first baseman Freddie Freeman returned to action after missing two games due to knee soreness. Freeman went 0-for-4. Marlins right fielder Owen Caissie left the game in the third inning due to right hamstring tightness. Tyler Glasnow (4-1) took his first loss since August 30, 2025. He struck out seven Marlins in four innings but allowed five hits, four walks and four runs. Reliever Cade Gibson (4-1) earned the win, pitching 1 1/3 innings of scoreless ball. He was followed out of the bullpen by Tyler Zuber, Calvin Faucher, Michael Petersen and Pete Fairbanks. It was Fairbanks' 19th save of the season and his first since August 11. The Dodgers opened the scoring in the first inning as Betts and Muncy hit homers on consecutive at-bats. Miami took a 3-2 lead in the second as Caissie walked, and Pauley tied it with his two-run homer. Then with two outs in the same frame, the Marlins stroked three straight singles, with Lopez getting the RBI knock. The Marlins extended their lead to 4-2 in the fifth as Glasnow walked the first two batters -- Griffin Conine on four pitches and then Lopez. The Dodgers brought in reliever Jack Dreyer, who balked, hit Jakob Marsee and then gave up Javier Sanoja's RBI groundout. That run was charged to Glasnow. With two outs and none on in the ninth, Dodgers rookie Josue De Paula walked and scored on Hunter Feduccia's single. But Fairbanks got Will Smith on a liner to third baseman Sanoja to end the game. --Field Level Media

item.title: K-pop superstar Lisa sparks fan frenzy at TIFF documentary premiere
item.description: K-pop star Lisa was met by piercing screams from fans as she walked the red carpet at the Toronto International Film Festival for the premiere of her new documentary, "Always Lalisa."
item.dc:creator: Kate Skelly
item.content:encoded: K-pop star Lisa was met by piercing screams from fans as she walked the red carpet at the Toronto International Film Festival for the premiere of her new documentary, "Always Lalisa." Lisa rose to fame as a member of the K-pop girl group Blackpink, and the film follows a year in her life after taking a break from the band to embark on a solo career. "I just tried to find new things — like what can I do more than this?" she told Reuters in an interview after the Friday premiere. The star, whose full name is Lalisa Manobal, said she initially thought a year would be long enough, but is still trying to figure out what she loves and her next challenge. "Always Lalisa" captures her triumphs and setbacks between 2024 and 2025, documenting the release of her debut solo album "Alter Ego," her acting debut in HBO's hit series "[USN:L2N3EY03P TEXT:"The White Lotus"]" and preparations to perform on her own before huge crowds at the Coachella music festival. The documentary was directed by Sue Kim, an executive producer on Apple TV's 2024 documentary series "K-Pop Idols." "This is this incredible opportunity to get to know someone who we're only ever given a very specific image of because of the music system that she comes from. We get to have this unprecedented access, proximity and exposure to her ... It's not the world of K-pop,” Kim told Reuters. After Lisa's return to the group, Blackpink in February made a return with the mini-album "DEADLINE," their first release in more than three years. "Always Lalisa" opens in cinemas on October 12.

item.title: Tennis/US Open-Rybakina remporte la finale de l'US Open face à Sabalenka
item.description: Elena Rybakina s'est imposée samedi lors de la finale féminine de l'US Open face à la tenante du titre Aryna Sabalenka 6-4 5-7 6-2, remportant ainsi un troisième sacre en Grand Chelem.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Elena Rybakina s'est imposée samedi lors de la finale féminine de l'US Open face à la tenante du titre Aryna Sabalenka 6-4 5-7 6-2, remportant ainsi un troisième sacre en Grand Chelem. Avec cette victoire, la Kazakhe, nouvelle numéro un mondiale, a contrarié la Biélorusse en l'empêchant de devenir la première joueuse depuis Serena Williams à remporter trois titres consécutifs à l'US Open. La finale disputée samedi au stade Arthur Ashe réunissait tous les ingrédients d'un match historique entre les deux premières du classement. Bien qu'Aryna Sabalenka se soit montrée plus offensive en fin de match, Elena Rybakina est restée imperturbable et s'est imposée pour remporter le prix de 5,5 millions de dollars. Elena Rybakina a ouvert le score pour mener 3-2 à la suite d'une double faute de son adversaire. Aryna Sabalenka, frustrée, s'est vu infliger une pénalité pour violation du code immédiatement après pour avoir lancé une balle haut dans les tribunes du court central. Une baisse soudaine du niveau de jeu d'Elena Rybakina au milieu du deuxième set a redonné espoir à Aryna Sabalenka, mais la Kazakhe a fini par prendre une avance confortable avant de sceller sa victoire.

item.title: Springboks beat All Blacks again to clinch tour series
item.description: World champions South Africa beat New Zealand for a third successive weekend to win the “Rugby’s Greatest Rivalry” series 3-1 as they took the last of four tests 43-28 on Saturday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: World champions South Africa beat New Zealand for a third successive weekend to win the “Rugby’s Greatest Rivalry” series 3-1 as they took the last of four tests 43-28 on Saturday. The Springboks outscored the All Blacks six tries to four with Damian de Allende, Morne van den Berg, Malcolm Marx, Pieter-Steph du Toit, Kurt-Lee Arendse and Cameron Hanekom all going over. New Zealand captain Codie Taylor scored the first try of the game, with Will Jordan, Ethan Blackadder and Beauden Barrett adding scores of their own. The clash in the United States concluded New Zealand’s eight-match, six-week tour of South Africa that was the first of its kind in 30 years. South Africa put over an early penalty, but the first try of the game went to the Kiwis, with Taylor bursting over from close range in the eighth minute after a wave of attacks, characterised by swift short passes and slick handling skills as the All Blacks got a quick ball from the ruck. The Springbok response came in similar fashion as they ran the ball directly at the opposing defence and after pounding away saw De Allende go over to score. Scrumhalf van den Berg sold a dummy to dart over from a line-out maul in the 22nd minute and see South Africa’s lead extend to 10 points but momentum quickly shifted back New Zealand’s way, and after repeated battering at Bok defences through 32 phases, Jordan burst over to extend his try-scoring record to 55 and reduce the halftime score to 17-14. BOMB SQUAD GAVE SPRINGBOKS QUICK IMPETUS IN SECOND HALF South Africa’s bomb squad went on early in the second half to bolster the scrums, and an early penalty led to a line-out maul from which South Africa pushed their way over with Marx claiming the try. Two minutes later, Van den Berg’s break led to Du Toit muscling over to put South Africa 29-14 ahead. Momentum then swung between the two tired-looking teams, taking on each other for a fourth successive Saturday. A long kick upfield won New Zealand a 63rd-minute line-out, and Blackadder finished off after scrumhalf Cam Roigard had broken the defensive lines. The All Blacks threatened to fight their way back into the contest after that, but Arendse's solo try nine minutes from time provided relief for the Boks and gave them some breathing room on the scoreboard. Arendse jinked his way through the field before sprinting away for a game-winning effort, with Cam Hanekom’s try straight after confirming South Africa’s series success. New Zealand did get a consolation try through veteran Barrett, who came on as a late substitute for a cameo appearance. The clash at the home of the NFL’s Baltimore Ravens drew 68,173 spectators in a money-spinning exercise for both unions. The series began last month with New Zealand playing provincial opponents, before winning the first test in Johannesburg, but South Africa took the next three to keep up their top ranking.

item.title: From injury fears to triumph, 'everything aligned' at US Open, says Rybakina
item.description: The stars aligned in Elena Rybakina's favour for a U.S. Open triumph the Kazakh never expected on Saturday, as she leaves New York the champion and new world number one despite an injury that nearly derailed her campaign.
item.dc:creator: Amy Tennery
item.content:encoded: The stars aligned in Elena Rybakina's favour for a U.S. Open triumph the Kazakh never expected on Saturday, as she leaves New York the champion and new world number one despite an injury that nearly derailed her campaign. Rybakina beat the twice defending champion Aryna Sabalenka for the trophy little more than three weeks after an [USN:L6N44Q06W TEXT:"ankle injury"] that forced her out of the Cincinnati tune-up tournament, raising serious questions over whether she would even compete in New York. "I was so upset. I didn't know actually how it's going to be day by day. We arrive in New York. We did MRI. It didn't look that great. We had to talk with a lot of doctors to get opinions (on) what we should do," she said. "For seven days I was just going from my hotel room to the gym, three hours there spending, a lot of recovery, treatments." Fears over her fitness slowly melted away through a series of [USN:L6N44T18D TEXT:"comprehensive victories"], as she beat twice winner Naomi Osaka to get past the fourth round for the first time and overcame the 2023 champion Coco Gauff in the semi-final. And she marched confidently into Arthur Ashe Stadium on Saturday, having already assured an end to Sabalenka's 99-week run at the top of the rankings. "It's tough to find words right now, honestly. I didn't expect nothing like this coming to this tournament," said Rybakina, after collecting her third major title and second of the season. "Somehow everything aligned together." The win marks the latest chapter in a prolific rivalry, the 18th meeting between the two players in a compelling cat-and-mouse saga. Rybakina beat Sabalenka in the title match at the 2025 WTA Finals, before besting the Belarusian in the Australian Open final little more than two months later. Sabalenka took the momentum back - for a handful of weeks, at least - as she beat the Kazakh in the Indian Wells final and in the penultimate stage in Miami. "I don't know what future will bring, but it's always very difficult matches against Aryna, and I feel like we push each other to be better after such tough battles," she told reporters. "I feel like not only with her, with also other players, top players. You always want to try something new, to change in your game, to be better. "I don't know what future is going to bring, but I hope success and some more wins."

item.title: Joey Logano blazes to pole for Enjoy Illinois 300
item.description: MADISON, Ill.--With a spectacular lap late in Saturday's NASCAR Cup Series qualifying session, Joey Logano won the pole for Sunday's Enjoy Illinois 300 at World Wide Technology Raceway at Gateway by a wide margin.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: MADISON, Ill.--With a spectacular lap late in Saturday's NASCAR Cup Series qualifying session, Joey Logano won the pole for Sunday's Enjoy Illinois 300 at World Wide Technology Raceway at Gateway by a wide margin. The only competitor in the 36-driver field to crack the 33-second barrier, Logano covered the 1.25-mile distance in 32.817 seconds (137.124 mph) to claim the top starting spot for the second race in the Cup Series Chase. It marked the second pole this season for Logano, who won the inaugural Cup Series race at WWTR in 2022. In winning his first pole at the track and the 35th of his career, Logano beat second-place qualifier Kyle Larson (135.980 mph) by 0.276 seconds. "Honestly, I feel like I've had good cars here for qualifying -- I just have always screwed up Turn 1," said Logano, who is eighth in the Chase standings, 72 points out of the lead. "It's nice to have a good, clean lap. "It's in your head, right? Before you go out because you've had four qualifying sessions before where you've always screwed up Turn 1. I've overdriven it. I've underdriven it because of that. "I hit it right this time, so that part was good. I was able to get through it pretty well and have a pretty solid (Turns) 3 and 4, and the car did what it needed to do. The car has got some raw speed in it, which is very encouraging for (Sunday)." Logano is the only driver in the field who has finished in the top five in each of the four previous races at Gateway. Chase drivers claimed the top 10 positions during time trials, with Logano's Team Penske teammate, Ryan Blaney, qualifying third at 135.898 mph and last Sunday's Darlington winner, Christopher Bell, earning the fourth spot on the grid at 135.767 mph. Chase Briscoe was fifth fastest, followed by Carson Hocevar, Bubba Wallace, Chase Elliott, Ty Gibbs and series leader Denny Hamlin, who improved significantly from his 30th position on the speed chart during practice earlier in the day. The remaining six Chase drivers qualified as follows: Austin Cindric 13th, Ryan Preece 14th, Daniel Suarez 15th, Tyler Reddick 18th, Chris Buescher 21st and William Byron 24th. For the second straight week, Buescher's No. 17 Ford failed inspection twice, resulting in the ejection of crew chief Joshua Sisco and the loss of pit selection for Sunday's race. --Reid Spencer, NASCAR Wire Service. Special to Field Level Media

item.title: Padres pick up sixth straight win, beat Giants
item.description: Jackson Merrill and Fernando Tatis Jr. hit home runs, Michael King overcame a shaky start to complete seven innings, and the visiting San Diego Padres overtook the San Francisco Giants for a sixth consecutive win, 7-6 on Saturday afternoon.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: Jackson Merrill and Fernando Tatis Jr. hit home runs, Michael King overcame a shaky start to complete seven innings, and the visiting San Diego Padres overtook the San Francisco Giants for a sixth consecutive win, 7-6 on Saturday afternoon. Dustin Harris drove in three runs and Xander Bogaerts had four hits for the Padres (80-68), who now sit a game and a half ahead of the Arizona Diamondbacks for the third and final National League wild-card playoff spot after the Diamondbacks lost later Saturday. Down 2-0 after Rafael Devers' 37th home run in the first inning the Padres scored in six consecutive innings to build a 7-3 lead. After tying the game at 2-2 in the second, the Padres fell behind 3-2 on Shay Whitcomb's blast in bottom of the second. Merrill's homer, his 25th, tied the game at 3 in the third, and Tatis' 21st made it 6-3 in the sixth. In between, Harris had a sacrifice fly and Jake Cronenworth a run-producing bunt single. Giants starter Cesar Perdomo (0-1) couldn't finish the fifth, having allowed five runs and 10 hits in 4 2/3 innings. He walked two and struck out three. King (11-9) was pulled with a 7-3 lead after the seventh, having set down 16 of the final 18 batters he faced. He was charged with three runs on five hits, striking out four and walking none. The Giants (62-87) made things interesting in the eighth when Drew Cavanaugh led off with his first career homer and Drew Gilbert followed two batters later with a two-run blast. Adrian Morejon came on at that point and retired the middle of the San Francisco lineup in order to preserve the one-run lead. Mason Miller, called upon for the second straight day, threw a 1-2-3 ninth with a pair of strikeouts for his 36th save. Austin Hays collected two hits and scored twice for the Padres, who beat the Giants for the eighth time in 12 tries this season. Bogaerts also scored twice, while Tatis had a single to complement his homer. Gilbert amassed two hits, two runs and two RBIs for the Giants, who fell to 15-26 in one-run games. --Field Level Media

item.title: Una implacable Rybakina destrona a Sabalenka y se alza con su primer título del Abierto de EEUU
item.description: Elena Rybakina mostró un tenis arrollador para destronar el sábado a la bicampeona Aryna Sabalenka con una victoria por 6-4, 5-7 y 6-2 en la final del Abierto de Estados Unidos, lo que le valió su tercer título de Grand Slam, junto al ascenso al número uno del mundo.
item.dc:creator: Shrivathsa Sridhar
item.content:encoded: Elena Rybakina mostró un tenis arrollador para destronar el sábado a la bicampeona Aryna Sabalenka con una victoria por 6-4, 5-7 y 6-2 en la final del Abierto de Estados Unidos, lo que le valió su tercer título de Grand Slam, junto al ascenso al número uno del mundo. La fría serenidad de la kazaja de origen ruso le ayudó a romper la racha de 20 victorias consecutivas de Sabalenka en Flushing Meadows y le negó a la bielorrusa la oportunidad de emular a Serena Williams y Chris Evert con tres títulos consecutivos en Nueva York. Una lesión en el tobillo había amenazado con descarrilar la campaña de Rybakina incluso antes de que comenzara el torneo, pero la tenista de 27 años hizo caso omiso de esas preocupaciones para sumar el título del Abierto de Estados Unidos a su triunfo en el Abierto de Australia de este año y a su éxito en Wimbledon en 2022. La final del sábado en el estadio Arthur Ashe reunía todos los ingredientes de un clásico entre las dos primeras del ranking y, aunque Sabalenka se mostró agresiva en los últimos compases, Rybakina se mantuvo imperturbable, como es habitual en ella, y se impuso para embolsarse el premio de 5,5 millones de dólares. Vestida con un conjunto amarillo y negro que evocaba a una abeja, Rybakina realizó algunos golpes de fondo punzantes, pero no supo aprovechar la presión inicial, ya que Sabalenka desató potentes servicios para mantenerse firme en el tercer enfrentamiento entre ambas en una final de Grand Slam. La segunda cabeza de serie se adelantó 3-2 tras una doble falta de Sabalenka, y la frustrada bielorrusa recibió una amonestación por infringir el código inmediatamente después por lanzar una pelota muy alto hacia las gradas de la pista principal. La irritación de Sabalenka se hizo cada vez más evidente con cada golpe fallido y cada oportunidad desperdiciada, en marcado contraste con la calma que se reflejaba en el rostro de Rybakina, mientras la kazaja afianzaba su dominio en el primer set y se lo adjudicaba con un juego muy reñido. Un repentino bajón en el nivel de Rybakina a mitad del segundo set dio esperanzas a Sabalenka, de 28 años, quien realizó un delicado golpe cortado y un impresionante tiro ganador de revés cruzado que le permitió forzar el set decisivo. Sabalenka soltó un enorme grito tras otro golpe ganador de revés para mantener su servicio en un reñido primer juego del tercer set. Sin embargo, la calidad de Rybakina brilló al tomar una ventaja dominante de 5-2 y, a continuación, cerrar un triunfo que dejó a su rival bielorrusa sin un título importante en 2026.

item.title: ベネチア映画祭、金獅子賞に「Woman Unknown」 唯一の女性監督作
item.description:
Crispian Balmer
[ヴェネチア １２日 ロイター] - 第８３回ベネチア国際映画祭の授賞式が１２日に行われ、コンペティション部門最高賞の金獅子賞をデンマークのメイ・エルトーキー監督の戦後ドラマ「Woman
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Crispian Balmer

[ヴェネチア １２日 ロイター] - 第８３回ベネチア国際映画祭の授賞式が１２日に行われ、コンペティション部門最高賞の金獅子賞をデンマークのメイ・エルトーキー監督の戦後ドラマ「Woman Unknown（原題）」が獲得した。

同部門に出品されていた是枝裕和監督の「ルックバック」と塚本晋也監督の「ネルソンさん、あなたは人を殺しましたか？」の受賞はならなかった。

エルトーキー監督はコンペ部門に出品された２１作品の中で唯一の女性監督。第二次世界大戦直後のデンマークを舞台にし、ある家政婦がドイツ兵とのつながりによって将来を脅かされる姿を描いた。家政婦を演じたマティルデ・アーセルは主演女優賞を受賞した。

受賞スピーチに立ったエルトーキー監督は、作品について「目に見えず、見過ごされ、声を上げられない女性たちの物語でもある」と語った。

また、銀獅子賞（審査員大賞）には韓国のイ・チャンドン監督が手がけた「もしもの愛」、最優秀監督賞はロシア出身のイリヤ・クルジャノフスキー監督が「DAU（原題）」で獲得。主演男優賞にはマーティン・マクドナー監督のコメディー「ワイルド・ホース・ナイン」で年老いた米中央情報局（ＣＩＡ）工作員を演じたジョン・マルコビッチが選ばれた。

このほか、審査員特別賞はイスラエルのユバル・アブラハム、レイチェル・ゾール両監督によるドキュメンタリー「NAZA（原題）」が受賞。２４人のイスラエル情報機関員と兵士への匿名インタビューに基づく同作品は、イスラエル軍がパレスチナ自治区ガザでの作戦で民間人の犠牲を日常的に容認していると非難。イスラエルはこうした主張を否定している。

今年のベネチア映画祭は、コンペ部門のほぼ全てが男性監督の作品であることに一部で批判も出た。運営側はそうした見方を否定し、選考が芸術的価値に基づいて行われたと擁護。審査委員長の米俳優兼監督のマギー・ギレンホール氏もこの問題に懸念を表明したが、金獅子賞が性別を理由に授与されたわけではないと語った。

item.title: Necaxa de México cesa a DT uruguayo Varini tras derrota en casa
item.description: Necaxa despidió el sábado al director técnico uruguayo Martín Varini, un día después de que el equipo sufrió una derrota en casa ante Puebla en la octava jornada del torneo Apertura del fútbol mexicano.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Necaxa despidió el sábado al director técnico uruguayo Martín Varini, un día después de que el equipo sufrió una derrota en casa ante Puebla en la octava jornada del torneo Apertura del fútbol mexicano. Varini llegó en diciembre a los "Rayos" de Necaxa, y al frente del equipo mexicano registró ocho triunfos, cinco empates y 14 derrotas. "El club agradece a Martín Varini y a su cuerpo técnico el trabajo realizado durante su etapa en Necaxa, así como el profesionalismo, compromiso y liderazgo mostrados al frente del equipo. Reconocemos también la disposición y responsabilidad que mostraron al representar a nuestra institución", informó Necaxa en un comunicado. Varini deja a Necaxa en el decimotercer lugar general del torneo Apertura con ocho puntos obtenidos después de dos triunfos, dos empates y cuatro derrotas. "En los próximos días informaremos quién asumirá la dirección técnica del primer equipo", agregó el club. El próximo compromiso de Necaxa será el 19 de septiembre cuando visite al Atlético de San Luis en la novena jornada del torneo Apertura.

item.title: Emmanuel Rodriguez homers in 1st AB as Twins clip Guardians
item.description: Emmanuel Rodriguez hit a home run in his first big-league plate appearance and the Minnesota Twins held on for a 4-3 win over the Cleveland Guardians on Saturday afternoon in Minneapolis.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: Emmanuel Rodriguez hit a home run in his first big-league plate appearance and the Minnesota Twins held on for a 4-3 win over the Cleveland Guardians on Saturday afternoon in Minneapolis. Royce Lewis went 1-for-3 with an RBI for Minnesota (70-78), which evened the three-game series with the rubber match set for Sunday. Kody Clemens and Victor Caratini added one RBI apiece. Travis Bazzana finished 1-for-3 with an RBI for Cleveland (75-74), which dropped to two games behind the Chicago White Sox in the American League Central. Steven Kwan and Brayan Rocchio each drove in a run. Twins left-hander Connor Prielipp (5-7) picked up his second victory in his past three starts. He held the Guardians to three runs on five hits in 5 1/3 innings, and he walked none and struck out one. Guardians right-hander Franco Aleman (0-1) was pelted for four runs on five hits in two-thirds of an inning. He walked none and struck out one. Twins left-hander A.J. Minter pitched a scoreless ninth for his first save. Cleveland scored the first run in the top of the second. Bazzana singled to center to drive in Jo Adell from second base. The Twins took the lead for good with a four-run third. Rodriguez started the big inning with a 420-foot homer to center in his first at-bat. Minnesota promoted the outfield prospect before the game. Clemens made it 2-1 with an RBI single to center, then Lewis followed two batters later with another RBI single to center to make it 3-1. Caratini capped the scoring when he was hit by a pitch in the foot with the bases loaded. The Guardians pulled within 4-3 in the fifth. Rocchio notched an RBI on a groundout that scored David Fry, then Kwan added an RBI single that scored Austin Hedges. Twins shortstop Kaelen Culpepper had to leave the game after he was hit by a rising fastball in the third. The team announced that Culpepper had a right shoulder contusion and that X-rays did not show a fracture. --Field Level Media

item.title: Ranger Suarez, Red Sox snap losing streak at Royals' expense
item.description: Ranger Suarez tossed his second straight seven-inning start and the Boston Red Sox scored in their final three at-bats en route to a 5-1 win over the visiting Kansas City Royals on Saturday afternoon.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: Ranger Suarez tossed his second straight seven-inning start and the Boston Red Sox scored in their final three at-bats en route to a 5-1 win over the visiting Kansas City Royals on Saturday afternoon. Suarez (7-4) struck out eight, scattered five hits and allowed one run while completing his seven frames in 96 pitches as Boston (81-68) snapped its three-game losing streak. Roman Anthony, Adley Rutschman and Nick Sogard each had multiple hits while Wilyer Abreu hit a two-run double that gave the Red Sox a sixth-inning lead they would not relinquish. Carter Jensen's 24th home run of the season marked the only scoring for Kansas City (66-83), which opened the series with a win Friday. The Red Sox took the lead with two runs on three straight hits in the sixth. After Mickey Gasper and Rutschman knocked back-to-back singles to right to chase Royals starter Randy Dobnak (3-4), Abreu drove them home with a two-out double to deep center off reliever Anthony Gose. The lead grew in each of the next two frames, beginning with Sogard hitting a leadoff double and scoring on Caleb Durbin's RBI single off the Green Monster in the seventh. After Garrett Whitlock struck out the side in the Royals' eighth, Trevor Story and Sogard posted back-to-back doubles to plate another run. Aroldis Chapman followed with a scoreless ninth to tab Suarez with the victory. The teams plowed through three scoreless innings with just one baserunner: Bobby Witt Jr.'s one-out single in Kansas City's opening frame. Suarez stranded him on third after recording back-to-back outs, including an inning-ending strikeout of Vinnie Pasquantino. Suarez retired the Royals 1-2-3 on 10 pitches in the second and third innings while Dobnak faced the minimum, striking out three batters through the first third of the game. In the fourth, Anthony turned a leadoff single through the right side into the opening run. After moving to second on Gasper's grounder, Anthony scored when Rutschman knocked a single into center. After finishing the fourth around Pasquantino's two-out double, Suarez retired five straight before Jensen's one-out solo homer inside Pesky's Pole in the sixth. The southpaw stranded runners in the next two frames, including back-to-back strikeouts to cap the seventh. --Field Level Media

item.title: Thiago Almada da triunfo agónico a River Plate en liga argentina
item.description: River Plate sacó el sábado un triunfo agónico de 2-1 en su visita a Atlético Tucumán gracias a un gol de Thiago Almada a los 91 minutos en la novena jornada del torneo Clausura del fútbol argentino.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: River Plate sacó el sábado un triunfo agónico de 2-1 en su visita a Atlético Tucumán gracias a un gol de Thiago Almada a los 91 minutos en la novena jornada del torneo Clausura del fútbol argentino. "Sabíamos que iba a ser muy duro, pero era importante sumar de a tres en esta cancha para nosotros. Me quedó justa la pelota y estoy muy feliz por el gol y la victoria", dijo Almada a la televisión local. River, que logró su tercer triunfo seguido, subió al quinto lugar con 13 puntos en la tabla de posiciones de la Zona B, cuatro de diferencia con el líder Argentinos Juniors. En el partido disputado en el estadio José Fierro de la provincia de Tucumán, River abrió el marcador a los 22 minutos por intermedio de Tobías Andrada con asistencia de Gonzalo Montiel. El empate para el conjunto local lo convirtió el paraguayo Clever Ferrería a los 83 minutos a través de un remate de cabeza. El gol del triunfo para el popular conjunto argentino llegó a los 91 minutos cuando Almada recibió en el punto penal y superó al portero Luis Ingolotti, luego de una buena acción de Juan Cruz Meza. Atlético Tucumán quedó con un hombre menos a los 13 minutos por la expulsión de Franco Nicola, quien recibió la tarjeta roja por una infracción sobre Lucas Martínez Quarta. "Teníamos el empate, pero nos hicieron el gol. Hay que rescatar el esfuerzo del equipo, que jugó todo el partido con diez, nos hizo daño haber quedado muy temprano con uno menos", dijo Ferreira a la televisión local. En otros partidos del sábado, Independiente Rivadavia de Mendoza venció por 4-3 como local a Aldosivi, mientras que Estudiantes de La Plata ganó por 2-1 en su estadio a Platense. El viernes, Boca Juniors derrotó por 3-1 a Central Córdoba con un doblete del paraguayo Ángel Romero y un gol del ecuatoriano Enner Valencia. Por su parte, Defensa y Justicia ganó 2-0 a Gimnasia y Esgrima de Mendoza, mientras que Newell's Old Boys y Vélez Sarsfield igualaron 1-1.

item.title: US Open women's singles champion Elena Rybakina
item.description: Factbox on Elena Rybakina, who beat Belarusian top seed Aryna Sabalenka 6-4 5-7 6-2 in the U.S. Open final to win her third Grand Slam title on Saturday:
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Factbox on Elena Rybakina, who beat Belarusian top seed Aryna Sabalenka 6-4 5-7 6-2 in the U.S. Open final to win her third Grand Slam title on Saturday: Age: 27 Nation: Kazakhstan WTA ranking: 2 Seeding: 2 Grand Slam titles: 3 (Wimbledon 2022, Australian Open 2026, U.S. Open 2026) EARLY LIFE * Began playing tennis at the age of six. * Born in Moscow, Rybakina switched allegiance to Kazakhstan in 2018. CAREER TO DATE * Began her professional career on the ITF Circuit in 2014. * Won two ITF doubles titles in 2017, followed by one singles and one doubles title in 2018. * Claimed her maiden WTA title in Bucharest in 2019, beating Patricia Maria Tig in the final, and broke into the top 50. * Reached the finals at four of her first five events in 2020 before the WTA Tour was suspended for more than five months due to the COVID-19 pandemic. Won her second WTA title in Hobart and became the first Kazakh player to break into the WTA top 20. * Reached the French Open quarter-finals in 2021 and finished the year ranked 14th. * Defeated Ons Jabeur in her first Wimbledon final in 2022 to win her maiden Grand Slam title. * Reached her second Grand Slam final at the 2023 Australian Open, where she lost to Sabalenka in three sets, and made her top-10 debut after the tournament. * Won three titles from five finals in 2024, lifting trophies in Brisbane, Abu Dhabi and Stuttgart, while finishing runner-up in Doha and Miami. * Won three titles in 2025, adding Strasbourg and Ningbo crowns to her Riyadh triumph. Also captured her first WTA Finals title, beating world number one Sabalenka in the final. * Defeated Sabalenka again in the 2026 Australian Open final to win her second Grand Slam title. * Secured the world number one ranking by reaching the U.S. Open semi-finals and will become the first Kazakhstan player to reach the top of the women's rankings. She is guaranteed to take over the top spot when the rankings are updated on Monday. * Overcame an ankle injury that had threatened to derail her U.S. Open campaign before it began and went on to beat Sabalenka in the final, securing her third Grand Slam title.

item.title: Ruthless Rybakina dethrones Sabalenka to capture first US Open crown
item.description: Dressed in a yellow-and-black outfit that evoked a bee, Rybakina produced some stinging groundstrokes.
item.dc:creator: Shrivathsa Sridhar
item.content:encoded: [USN:L4N45402H TEXT:"Elena Rybakina"] delivered a devastating display to dethrone two-time defending champion Aryna Sabalenka with a 6-4 5-7 6-2 win in the [USN:L6N4530M0 TEXT:"U.S. Open"] final on Saturday, earning a third Grand Slam crown to accompany her ascent to world number one. The Russian-born Kazakh's icy composure on the grand stage helped her snap Sabalenka's 20-match winning streak at Flushing Meadows and denied the Belarusian the chance to emulate Serena Williams and Chris Evert with three straight New York titles. An [USN:L6N45408Y TEXT:"ankle injury"] had threatened to derail Rybakina's campaign even before the tournament started, but the 27-year-old shrugged off those concerns to add the U.S. Open title to her Australian Open triumph this year and Wimbledon success in 2022. "It's tough to find words ... I didn't expect anything like this coming into the tournament," said Rybakina, who became only the third woman this century to claim both hardcourt majors in the same year after Sabalenka and Angelique Kerber. "I've been dealing a bit with an injury. Somehow, everything aligned together on my side. Aryna ... it's so difficult to play against you. You push me to the limit. "I want to say thank you to the beautiful spectators for such a beautiful atmosphere. I'm falling in love with New York more and more." Saturday's title showdown at Arthur Ashe Stadium had all the ingredients of a classic between the top two in the rankings, and though Sabalenka brought late aggression, Rybakina was typically unruffled and prevailed to pocket the $5.5 million prize. "It's going to be different to wake up the next morning knowing you've won the U.S. Open and achieved the world number one ranking," said Rybakina, who collected her trophy from Russian five-time Grand Slam champion Maria Sharapova. "It's a relief, because you do all the routines for the past two to three weeks. It's a lot of work, a lot of nerves also." STINGING GROUNDSTROKES Dressed in a yellow-and-black match kit that evoked a bee, Rybakina produced some stinging groundstrokes but was unable to make the early pressure count as Sabalenka unleashed big serves to hold firm in the pair's third Grand Slam final meeting. The second seed drew first blood to go ahead 3-2 following a Sabalenka double fault, with the frustrated Belarusian earning a code violation immediately afterwards for launching a ball high into the stands of the main showcourt. "It's really tough to control your emotions when you lose in the final of the Grand Slam and when you're trying to go for the 'three-peat' so I wanted to let it go," Sabalenka said. "If I had held it inside, I wouldn't be able to say a word." Sabalenka's [USN:L1N45406Y TEXT:"irritation"] became increasingly evident with each missed shot and squandered opportunity, in stark contrast to the trademark calm etched on Rybakina's face as the Kazakh tightened her grip on the opening set and clinched it with a tight hold. A sudden drop-off in Rybakina's level midway through the second set gave the 28-year-old Sabalenka hope, and she produced a delicate drop shot and a stunning backhand crosscourt winner en route to forcing a deciding set. Sabalenka let out a roar after another backhand winner to hold in a tight opening game of the third set. COMMANDING LEAD However, Rybakina's quality shone through her red-and-blue-framed racket as she took a commanding 5-2 lead and then closed out a famous triumph to leave her Belarusian rival without any major silverware in 2026. The typically mild-mannered Rybakina's celebration had little more pizzazz than one might expect from a routine match victory, and she calmly packed her belongings at her bench as Sabalenka sat with her demolished racket. "It's the last thing I want to do right now, give a speech. But I'll try my very best," said a teary Sabalenka, who lost to Rybakina in the Australian Open final this year. "I'm disappointed, but I want to congratulate Elena. I wish I could perform a bit better, but I guess next year." The [USN:L6N45407L TEXT:"action"] resumes on Sunday with [USN:L6N454078 TEXT:"another final"], where Ben Shelton bids to end a 23-year American wait for a men's Grand Slam champion when he plays top seed Alexander Zverev.

item.title: Blue Jays outlast Orioles as teams battle to stay in playoff race
item.description: Alejandro Kirk belted a two-run home run and had three RBIs Saturday afternoon to help the Toronto Blue Jays defeat the visiting Baltimore Orioles 7-3.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: Alejandro Kirk belted a two-run home run and had three RBIs Saturday afternoon to help the Toronto Blue Jays defeat the visiting Baltimore Orioles 7-3. The teams have split the first two of the three-game series in their pursuit of an American League playoff spot. The Blue Jays (74-75) are one game behind the Cleveland Guardians (75-74) for the third and final AL wild-card spot. The Orioles (72-77) are three behind. Brett Bateman added a solo shot for the Blue Jays. Toronto opener Spencer Miles escaped a bases-loaded jam in the first on Christian Encarnacion-Strand's fly out to the warning track in right. The Blue Jays took a 2-0 lead against Kyle Bradish (7-14) in the home first. Bateman led off with a walk, Vladimir Guerrero Jr. stroked an RBI double to right-center with one out and Kirk followed with an RBI single to right. Bateman, who hit his first major league home run in the ninth on Friday, homered to right on a 1-1 fastball to open the home third. George Springer singled and Kirk connected with a first-pitch slider for a homer to left with one out to give Toronto a 5-0 lead. Bradish allowed five runs, eight hits and two walks with two strikeouts in three innings. Baltimore scored once in the fourth against Spencer Arrighetti (8-9). Gunnar Henderson smashed a one-out double into the right field corner and scored when Kazuma Okamoto bobbled Encarnacion-Strand's grounder and then threw high to first. The damage was limited when Encarnacion-Strand was thrown at home by Nathan Lukes on Colton Cowser's line single to right. Mason Fluharty replaced Arrighetti after Encarnacion-Strand took a two-out walk in the sixth. Pinch hitter Jeremiah Jackson doubled to right-center to put runners at second and third. Pinch hitter Rece Hinds ended the threat on a lineout to center. The Blue Jays scored a run against Anthony Nunez in their sixth. Josh Smith was hit by a pitch and scored on Andres Gimenez's double into the right field corner. Baltimore cut the lead to 6-3 in the seventh. Pinch hitter Yohel Pozo led off with a single against Fluharty. Pete Alonso homered down the left field line against Paul Sewald on a 1-2 sweeper. Toronto answered with a run in the bottom of the seventh. Guerrero was hit by a pitch, Lukes singled and Okamoto walked against Cam Sanders. Pinch hitter Ernie Clement greeted Luis De Leon with a sacrifice fly. --Field Level Media

item.title: Courteney Cox thriller tells 'dysfunctional love story' behind pizza bomber case at TIFF
item.description: Courteney Cox's true crime thriller "Evil Genius" recounting the infamous U.S. pizza bomber case premiered at the Toronto International Film Festival on Saturday.
item.dc:creator: Ryan Patrick Jones
item.content:encoded: Courteney Cox's true crime thriller "Evil Genius" recounting the infamous U.S. pizza bomber case premiered at the Toronto International Film Festival on Saturday. The film, starring Academy Award winner Patricia Arquette and "Stranger Things" actor David Harbour, is the "Friends" star's first feature film as a director in 12 years, following the 2014 black comedy "Just Before I Go." It is based on the 2018 Netflix documentary series "Evil Genius: The True Story of America's Most Diabolical Bank Heist." The movie centers on the convoluted plot in which pizza delivery man Brian Wells robbed a PNC Bank near Erie, Pennsylvania, in 2003 with a homemade bomb locked around his neck. The device detonated after his arrest, killing him. Arquette plays Marjorie Diehl-Armstrong, a woman with bipolar disorder who was later convicted of the robbery. Prosecutors said she masterminded it to raise money to hire a hit man to kill her estranged father over an inheritance dispute. Harbour co-stars as Bill Rothstein, her former fiancé and accomplice. His call to police - reporting the body of Diehl-Armstrong's boyfriend James Roden in his freezer and implicating her in the killing - broke the case open. Cox said on the red carpet she was drawn to the story by the unusual relationship between Diehl-Armstrong and Rothstein. "There's a dysfunctional love story that's really the catalyst for this heist," Cox said at the premiere. "There were some really humorous moments and also tragic, but I just thought 'I'm going to walk the line, tell the story with a tone that's ... not identifiable with any specific genre.'" Arquette said she strove to capture what motivated Diehl-Armstrong, who died in prison in 2017. "Oftentimes, people who are bad guys, they don't really see themselves as that. They have their reasons why that person's their enemy, or that person let them down, or they should have that thing, or how the world screwed them over," she said. "Understanding those underpinnings, I think, was the most important to me."

item.title: Rebel Wilson’s new film celebrates girl power after ‘setback’ in directorial debut
item.description: Australian actor Rebel Wilson returned to the Toronto International Film Festival with her second directorial feature “Girl Group,” which she told Reuters combined “comedy, music and fun,” following a legal battle surrounding her first film.
item.dc:creator: Zoe Law
item.content:encoded: Australian actor Rebel Wilson returned to the Toronto International Film Festival with her second directorial feature “Girl Group,” which she told Reuters combined “comedy, music and fun,” following a legal battle surrounding her first film. Wilson’s directorial debut “The Deb,” which premiered at the festival two years ago, was embroiled in legal disputes, delaying the film’s release in theaters. In July, a Sydney court [USN:P8N3X103B TEXT:"cleared "]Wilson of defaming The Deb's lead actor Charlotte MacInnes, who was appealing. “I was so happy to have a court rule overwhelmingly in my favor earlier this year. And I feel like ‘The Deb’ did have a setback because of the litigation that was brought by the other producers,” Wilson told Reuters in an interview on Saturday. “I, for the most part, kept my head down, worked on ‘Girl Group’ in the meantime and just had such a sensational, fun experience on that.” A separate lawsuit was filed against Wilson by "The Deb" producers in a U.S. court. Her new musical comedy follows the story of a disgraced pop star who was excluded from her former girl group’s reunion tour and has to mentor a group of young girls under a community-service sentence. “’Girl Group’ is a full-on celebration of girl group music from throughout like the past five decades,” said Wilson, who plays the lead while also directing, writing and producing the film. “It’s a story about friendship, about working together to create something great.” The film features real girl group legends, including Spice Girls' Melanie Chisholm, All Saints’ Shaznay Lewis and Pussycat Dolls’ Ashley Roberts and Nicole Scherzinger. Wilson said that her film was once rejected by a studio because it was a “female-driven” film. “I was shocked by that because I've been in these female-driven ensemble movies that were absolutely huge and made hundreds of millions of dollars,” said Wilson, who starred in “Bridesmaids” and the “Pitch Perfect” series. “Girl Group” premiered at TIFF on Friday, and a release date in theatres has not yet been announced.

item.title: Hao-Yu Lee fuels Tigers’ comeback win over Rockies
item.description: Hao-Yu Lee sparked a seven-run, eighth-inning rally with a double and capped it with a two-run triple as the host Detroit Tigers downed the struggling Colorado Rockies, 11-7, on Saturday.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: Hao-Yu Lee sparked a seven-run, eighth-inning rally with a double and capped it with a two-run triple as the host Detroit Tigers downed the struggling Colorado Rockies, 11-7, on Saturday. Lee had three hits, scored twice and drove in three runs. Max Clark supplied three hits while scoring a run and knocking in another. Eduardo Valencia also had three of Detroit's 18 hits while Kevin McGonigle added a solo homer for the Tigers (69-79). Detroit became the first team since Philadelphia on Sept. 23, 2024, to have its leadoff batter reach safely in eight consecutive innings. Hunter Goodman blasted a three-run homer for the Rockies (55-93), who have lost six straight. Detroit starter Andrew Sears gave up four runs and seven hits in 4 1/3 innings. Colorado starter Tanner Gordon allowed four runs and 10 hits in four innings. Down 7-4 in the eighth, the Tigers rallied against Jaden Hill (1-4). Lee led off with a double and scored on Gleyber Torres' double. Riley Greene knocked in Torres with a single. A single and a walk loaded the bases before Hill was replaced by Jordan Romano, who walked Spencer Torkelson and Ben Malgeri to force in the tying and go-ahead runs. John Peck drove in Clark with a sacrifice fly to make it 9-7. With two outs, Lee ripped an opposite-field triple to bring in Torkelson and Malgeri. Colorado took a 3-0 lead in the third on Goodman's 38th homer. Detroit got two of those runs back in the bottom of the inning. McGonigle powered a changeup over the right-field wall to lead off the frame. After back-to-back two-out singles by Greene and Valencia, Clark smacked another single to right to bring in Greene. The Rockies took a 4-2 lead in the fourth on Adael Amador's double. The Tigers knotted the score at 4-all in the bottom of the inning on Lee's run-scoring double and Colt Keith's RBI single. Colorado regained the lead in the sixth on Jake McCarthy's two-run single, then took a 7-4 lead on Ezequiel Tovar's homer off Beau Brieske (1-0) in the top of the eighth. --Field Level Media

item.title: OpenAI's Altman won't do IPO this year, calls AI extinction risk 'unacceptable'
item.description: He said even a slight chance of a risk of extinction was unacceptable.
item.dc:creator: Lisa Baertlein
item.content:encoded: OpenAI will not go public in 2026, Chief Executive Sam Altman said in remarks published on Saturday, citing safety concerns over artificial intelligence that render "unacceptable" even a 10% risk that AI could [USN:L6N4520JB TEXT:"cause human extinction"] by decade's end. The comments come as more U.S. [USN:L6N4520JA TEXT:"lawmakers"] urge new rules to govern AI systems after dire warnings from two researchers from OpenAI rival Anthropic that rapidly progressing AI could lead to the extinction of the human race in the not-too-distant future. "I actually think that, given everything happening with safety, right now would be an ill-advised moment to go public, and we don't feel pressure on that," Altman told business magazine Fortune. Asked if there was a 10% chance of AI-driven extinction, [USN:L4N3CN16E TEXT:"Altman"] said he did not know how such an estimate could be made, but warned the risk was serious enough that AI companies and governments should act as though it could not be tolerated. "Whether it's 10 or eight or six, the point is, we all have a tremendous amount of responsibility, and cannot let egos or incentives for profit or anything else get in the way," Altman added. "We need to act such that we are not taking any of those numbers of risk, and I believe we can." INSTANCES OF AI AGENTS GOING ROGUE Politicians, both Democrat and Republican, have responded with alarm and calls for more action after cases of AI agents going rogue to hack external systems and AI safety researchers quitting their companies out of concern at the technology risks. In June, the New York Times said San Francisco-based OpenAI was considering [USN:L4N42X21Q TEXT:"whether to hold off"] until next year on a potentially trillion-dollar IPO. At the time, shares in Elon Musk's SpaceX IPO were tumbling after a surge that sent that company's valuation to $1.8 trillion. Asked by Fortune if an IPO date of 2026 was off the table in favor of 2027, Altman said, "I would say not 2026. "We got a lot of stuff to do, like meeting this moment of what is going to be required for safety and alignment, and how the industry and governments can work together." Altman also suggested that OpenAI and other leading AI firms may be close to unveiling a pact to slow AI development and work together to tackle safety risks, Fortune said. CALL FOR MORE DELIBERATE APPROACH On Saturday, Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei urged AI companies to take a more [USN:L1N45403P TEXT:"deliberate approach"] to development. "We must slow the pace at which we improve the capabilities of AI models," Amodei wrote in an essay on X. Altman later posted that he agreed with the sentiment. "I agree with Dario that we need to pace the frontier," Altman wrote. "This has been a primary topic of discussions we've had at OpenAI in recent weeks." Safety concerns have not slowed Anthropic's own IPO plans. It is expected to [USN:L6N44W194 TEXT:"begin marketing"] its initial public offering in mid-October at the earliest and complete the listing days before the U.S. midterm elections in November, people familiar with the matter told Reuters this month.

item.title: Francisco Lindor powers Mets’ 6-homer rout of Yankees
item.description: Francisco Lindor, Luis Torrens and rookie Carson Benge homered off Gerrit Cole, and the visiting New York Mets rolled to a 12-2 victory over the New York Yankees on Saturday afternoon.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: Francisco Lindor, Luis Torrens and rookie Carson Benge homered off Gerrit Cole, and the visiting New York Mets rolled to a 12-2 victory over the New York Yankees on Saturday afternoon. Lindor added a grand slam in the eighth as the Mets (69-79) won for the fifth time in six games and improved to 22-13 since their big selloff at last month's trade deadline by hitting Cole (8-9) hard again. Rookie Zac Thornton (4-5) allowed two runs on five hits in a career-high-tying seven innings. The left-hander struck out four, walked one and threw first-pitch strikes to 17 of 26 hitters. Lindor got things started in the first inning by lifting a 1-1 changeup into the right-field seats. It was the shortstop's 36th career leadoff homer and fifth this season. Torrens homered for the seventh time in his past 27 appearances when he lifted a 1-2 fastball into the left-field seats for a 3-0 lead in the second inning. Benge added a solo shot in the third to push the Mets' advantage to 4-0. Benge added an RBI single that chased Cole from the contest with one out in the fifth. Juan Soto homered in the seventh, and Lindor hit his eighth career grand slam after Torrens hit an RBI double. Lindor has seven home runs in his past 12 games and 24 career multi-homer games. Jared Young also went deep with two outs in the ninth to give the Mets six homers against the Yankees for the first time. Cole was tagged for five runs on nine hits (three home runs) in 4 1/3 innings after allowing four homers in Sunday's loss at San Diego. He struck out four and didn't walk a batter as he matched his second-shortest outing since returning from Tommy John surgery on May 22. The right-hander has allowed 17 homers in 10 career starts against the Mets. He is 0-3 with a 10.93 ERA in his past three outings against them. The Yankees (85-63) had their four-game winning streak end. They entered the game needing both a win and a Toronto Blue Jays loss to secure a postseason berth for the ninth time in 10 seasons. Cody Bellinger hit a run-scoring single for the Yankees in the fourth. He added a solo homer in the sixth to pull the hosts to within 5-2 before the Mets put the game out of reach with a five-run eighth. --Field Level Media

KYIV: Russian air strikes in several Ukrainian regions on Saturday (Sep 12) killed n ine people, injured dozens and damaged residential buildings and infrastructure across the country, officials said. The civilian death toll has risen sharply in Ukraine over the past two months as Russia steps up attacks on power plants and other infrastructure. Ukraine has hit energy facilities and warehouses in distant parts of Russia and both sides have targeted each others' shipping. T he city council in Kramatorsk, one of Ukraine's frontline "fortress cities" that Russia wants to capture, said Russian forces attacked private cars, killing three people in three incidents over a 90-minute period. Four people were injured. "These are not military targets," the council said. "They are ordinary civilian cars. People were going about their business."

The governor of Ukraine's Zhytomyr Region, west of Kyiv, Vitaliy Bunechko, said a Russian strike on a grocery store killed two people in the town of Zvyahel. Two petrol stations also came under attack as well as an unidentified "enterprise with foreign investment", he said. Earlier, President Volodymyr Zelenskiy reported attacks on the southeastern city of Zaporizhzhia and in his home town of Kryvyi Rih. The governor of Zaporizhzhia Region, Ivan Fedorov, said two people were killed and 11 injured in assaults on Zaporizhzhia and other localities. Oleksandr Vilkul, head of Kryvyi Rih's military administration, said two people had been killed in overnight attacks on the city by drones and missiles.

The Russian military said its forces hit Ukrainian steel maker Zaporizhstal in the city of Zaporizhzhia, an Interpipe Steel complex in Dnipro and several plants in Kryvyi Rih, including the Northern Iron Ore Beneficiation Works complex. Reuters could not independently verify accounts from either side. In Odesa Region, Governor Oleh Kiper said 37 people, including an infant, had been injured in a series of overnight attacks. Two people were missing. RUSSIAN STRIKES ON UKRAINIAN PORT The Russian Defence Ministry said Moscow's forces had maintained their strikes on Ukrainian ports, hitting a cargo ship in Odesa it said was carrying goods for military use. Earlier in the day, the ministry said its forces had struck two cargo vessels overnight in the Black Sea port of Chornomorsk.

Ukraine's military said it hit one of Russia's largest synthetic rubber producers in Togliatti in the Samara region, causing a fire. The Togliattikauchuk plant specialised in the production of synthetic rubbers and fuel additives that are used in fuel for Russian missiles, it said. Russian regional governor Vyacheslav Fedorishchev said industrial facilities in Samara region had been attacked by Ukrainian drones, without specifying which they were or whether they had been damaged, Interfax news agency reported. Ilya Sukhikh, mayor of the city of Togliatti in Samara region, said several residential buildings were damaged and one person was injured. In a separate attack, four commercial properties were set ablaze in the city of Taganrog in the Rostov region, local mayor Svetlana Kambulova said, according to TASS.

item.title: Tesla to unveil long-delayed Roadster on Oct. 1, Musk says
item.description: Tesla CEO Elon Musk said on Saturday the electric-vehicle maker would unveil its long-delayed Roadster on October 1, nearly a decade after first revealing a next-generation version of its original sports car.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Tesla (TSLA.O) CEO Elon Musk said on Saturday the electric-vehicle maker would unveil its long-delayed Roadster on October 1, nearly a decade after first revealing a next-generation version of its original sports car. Here are some of the details: Tesla's account on social media platform X - also owned by Musk - posted "Go for launch" alongside a graphic displaying the date. Musk later replied to the post, saying, "New Tesla Roadster Unveil 10.01" The Information [USN:L6N44B0T5 TEXT:"reported in August"] that Tesla planned to unveil a redesigned Roadster as early as that month. The unveiling event could include a demonstration of a limited-edition version equipped with cold-gas thrusters developed in collaboration with SpaceX (SPCX.O) , the report said, The Information report added that the demonstration is expected to take place at SpaceX's test facility in McGregor, Texas. Tesla first unveiled the next-generation Roadster in 2017 and said deliveries would begin in 2020, but the program has faced repeated delays. This comes after Tesla last week began offering rides in its two-seater [USN:L6N44V1CY TEXT:"Cybercab"], which has no steering wheel or pedals, in limited areas of Austin, Texas. Musk has described the vehicle as central to transforming Tesla into a dominant force in driverless vehicles. The Roadster program has reportedly evolved from a conventional high-performance EV into an all-new carbon-fiber hypercar after Tesla abandoned an alternative approach based on Model S Plaid components.

item.title: OpenAIの年内上場は見送り、AI安全性巡る不安への対応に集中へ－CEO
item.description:
（ブルームバーグ）： 米OpenAIは、予定していた新規株式公開（IPO）の年内実施を見送る。サム・アルトマン最高経営責任者（CEO）が、米経済誌フォーチュンとのインタビューで明らかにした。AIの安全性を巡る不安への対応に集中する。
12日に公開されたインタビュー動画によると、アルトマンCEOは、IPOの時期として、今年は「賢明なタイミングではない」と述べ、上場が2027年以降になるとの見通しを示した。
item.dc:creator: Bloomberg
item.content:encoded:
（ブルームバーグ）： 米OpenAIは、予定していた新規株式公開（IPO）の年内実施を見送る。サム・アルトマン最高経営責任者（CEO）が、米経済誌フォーチュンとのインタビューで明らかにした。AIの安全性を巡る不安への対応に集中する。

12日に公開されたインタビュー動画によると、アルトマンCEOは、IPOの時期として、今年は「賢明なタイミングではない」と述べ、上場が2027年以降になるとの見通しを示した。 OpenAIは、米証券取引委員会（SEC）にIPO申請書類を非公開で今年6月に提出したが、上場時期は未定としていた。

一方、同社と共にAI開発競争の先頭を走るアンソロピックも申請書類を非公開で既に提出しており、数週間以内に書類を一般公開し、正式な上場申請手続きに入る準備を進めているもようだ。IPO規模は過去最高だった米宇宙開発企業スペースXの862億ドル（約13兆2400億円）規模に匹敵するか、それを上回ると見込まれる。

アンソロピックがAIの安全性に関し無責任な対応を取っており、AIは「この10年の終わりまでにわれわれ全員を殺してしまう危険がある」と懸念する同社の研究者が今週辞職し、人類存亡に関わるAIの潜在的脅威の不安が本格化した。

同社の現職の従業員は、そうした結果を招く確率が「今後10年以内で10%を超える」とX（旧ツイッター）に投稿した。

アルトマン氏は「この10年の終わりまでに人類全員が死亡するリスクが10%というような状況は受け入れ難い」と発言。「われわれは今この瞬間、新たな時代に入りつつある。過去に別の時代に足を踏み入れた時と同様、このアイデアが全人類の利益となり、そのようなリスクを誰も冒さないよう確実を期すため、異なる行動が求められる可能性が高い」と語った。

アンソロピックのダリオ・アモデイCEOは12日、AIが人類に及ぼすリスクの高まりを理由にAI開発のペースを落とす必要があると警告した。アルトマン氏とxAIの共同創業者イーロン・マスク氏もアモデイ氏の投稿に直ちに同調した。AI分野で競合する主要3社のトップが一致した見解を示す異例の事態となった。

item.title: Larry Ellison cancels plan to sell Oracle stock worth up to $7.5 billion
item.description: Oracle shares are down nearly 23% year to date.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Oracle said on Saturday that its co-founder and executive chairman Larry Ellison had canceled a plan to sell up to 50 million Oracle shares, worth about $7.5 billion at Friday's closing price. Oracle had disclosed in a regulatory filing Friday that Ellison had adopted the trading plan on June 22, 2026, and that it was scheduled to expire on October 24, 2026. "No Oracle stock was sold under that plan, and he has no other plans to sell any of his Oracle stock," Oracle said on Saturday. Oracle's stock has taken a beating this year on growing investor concerns over soaring capital expenditure that has pressured its free cash flow. The shares are down nearly 23% year to date and were more than 18% below their closing level on June 18, the last trading day before Ellison adopted the plan. Oracle did not give a reason for the cancellation of Ellison's trading plan. Ellison, 82, served as Oracle's CEO until 2014 and is the company's largest shareholder, owning over 38% of the company, according to LSEG data. Earlier in the week, Oracle had [USN:L4N4521KU TEXT:"reported"] quarterly results that topped Wall Street estimates and a smaller cash burn than expected, easing some concerns about its debt-fueled spending spree and leading to a jump in the shares on Friday. However, its stock later reversed course as analysts said a recovery in cash flow remained some way off. The firm also [USN:L4N4530RH TEXT:"announced"] restructuring costs, part of a plan that includes job cuts, will rise by about $700 million.

item.title: オラクルのエリソン会長、時価75億ドル相当の保有株売却取りやめ
item.description: （ブルームバーグ）：
item.dc:creator: Bloomberg
item.content:encoded:
（ブルームバーグ）： 米クラウド事業大手オラクルのラリー・エリソン会長は、時価75億ドル（約1兆1500億円）に相当する保有株最大5000万株の売却を取りやめた。同氏の株式売却計画は、オラクルが前日に開示したばかりだ。

オラクルは「この計画に基づくオラクル株の売却は行われておらず、エリソン氏には他に保有株売却の計画はない」との声明を発表した。同社は前日、エリソン氏が10月24日までに最大5000万株を売却できるプログラムを通じて株式を手放す意向だと発表していた。

この計画が6月22日に承認された時点で、対象株式の価値は約87億5000万ドルだったが、株価はその後16%下落した。エリソン氏は同社株の約40%を保有している。

クラウド技術を手掛けるオラクルは、OpenAIなどの顧客に関連するAI事業に巨額を投資している。こうした支出がバランスシートに重くのしかかり、投資家からの圧力は強まっている。手元資金を温存するために数千人規模の人員削減に着手した同社は11日、その費用が推定28億ドルに上り、従来予想から7億ドル増加したと明らかにした。

エリソン氏の売却計画撤回は、こうした懸念をある程度和らげる可能性がある。オラクル株は11日、粗利益率の低下を報告したことが嫌気され、支出計画を巡る懸念から1.7%下落した。

ラリー・エリソン氏は、息子デービッド・エリソン氏の事業活動を資金面で大きく支援してきた。これにはパラマウント・スカイダンスが1100億ドルで提案しているワーナー・ブラザース・ディスカバリー買収も含まれる。

原題：Ellison Ends Plan to Sell Up to $7.5 Billion in Oracle Stock (1)（抜粋）

item.title: Trump says he would 'love' to see a united Ireland
item.description: Trump's comments come during a visit to Dublin and weeks after new British Prime Minister Andy Burnham said a referendum on Northern Ireland leaving the United Kingdom was "off the table".
item.dc:creator: CNA
item.content:encoded:

Trump says he would 'love' to see a united Ireland

Trump's comments come during  a visit to Dublin and weeks after new British Prime Minister Andy Burnham said a referendum on Northern Ireland leaving the United Kingdom was "off the table".

FAST

DUBLIN: US President Donald Trump said on Saturday (Sep 12) he would "love" to see British-run Northern Ireland unify with Ireland , remarks made during a visit to Dublin that drew a sharp response from pro-British unionists in Northern Ireland . Trump's comments come weeks after new British Prime Minister Andy Burnham said a referendum on Northern Ireland leaving the United Kingdom was "off the table", a position Downing Street on Saturday said remained unchanged. "Well, I don't want to cause any problems, but I will tell you, I'd love to see it unified," Trump told reporters sitting next to Irish Prime Minister Micheal Martin after the pair met in Dublin. "It's going to happen eventually ... I think it would be a fantastic thing." "Now the UK will have something to say about it ... but I think it would be a great thing," he added. COMMENTS BREAK WITH NEUTRAL STANCE OF PREVIOUS PRESIDENTS

Trump later said that there "was no good answer" to the question on Irish unity but repeated that he thought it would be "a very cool thing". Under the terms of the 1998 Good Friday Agreement, a referendum can be held only at the discretion of the British government. The accord ended three decades of violence between Irish nationalists seeking a united Ireland and unionists who wanted Northern Ireland to remain part of the UK. While polls show a comfortable majority in Northern Ireland favour remaining in the UK, the gap has narrowed slightly since Britain's departure from the European Union pushed unity higher up the political agenda.

Related:

CNA938 Rewind - Speaking His Mind – Leo Varadkar & life as Ireland’s Taoiseach

Belfast violence fuelled by anti-migrant accounts online

The leader of the Democratic Unionist Party, Northern Ireland 's largest party advocating continued union with Britain, rejected Trump's prediction, saying unification with Ireland would lead to "the destruction of our country." "Northern Ireland 's constitutional future will be decided by the people of Northern Ireland , not by commentary in London, Dublin or Washington," Gavin Robinson, who has publicly supported Trump in the past, wrote on X. In Belfast, supporters of Irish unity gave a guarded response. "I think it's just headline grabbing ... I don't think he gives a toss whether there is a United Ireland or not," said Eamon Hanna, a supporter of the nationalist SDLP party, which has been a strong critic of Trump's policies. Previous US presidents, including those with strong Irish heritage like Joe Biden, have been careful to remain neutral on Irish unification. The US government played a key role in brokering the 1998 peace deal. 'YOU FLEECED US' Trump also met Irish President Catherine Connolly, who had joined a protest against his 2019 visit to Ireland , before she was elected to the mostly ceremonial role last year. Connolly, formerly a long-time left-wing lawmaker, said in a statement that she conveyed to Trump "the strong view of the Irish people that the normalisation of war and genocide can never be accepted."

US President Donald Trump gestures besides Irish President Catherine Connolly at Aras an Uachtarain in Dublin, Ireland, Sep 12, 2026. (Photo: REUTERS/Kylie Cooper)

Her statement did not reference any conflict, but she has been previously critical of the US war with Iran and Israel's assault on Gaza, which Ireland , in common with a UN inquiry and several human rights groups, has described as a genocide. Israel rejects that characterisation, saying that it is fighting the militants who attacked it from the Palestinian enclave in 2023. Thousands of protesters, some holding posters calling Trump a warmonger and chanting "Free free Palestine", marched through central Dublin shortly after Trump left to watch a golf tournament at one of his resorts in the west of Ireland . It was one of the country's largest anti-war protests in recent years. The centrist premier Martin had earlier focused his remarks on the countries' close economic ties. US-owned companies, mainly in the technology and pharmaceutical sectors, employ about 10 percent of workers in Ireland after successive governments prioritised the companies' jobs and tax revenues over decades. "You took all our medical companies, we've got to get a couple of them back," Trump said. "You fleeced us but that's okay. There's a lot of room to go around and our relationship with you is fantastic."

Source: Reuters/fs

Sept 12 : British fintech Revolut confirmed that sensitive customer information was disclosed to an unauthorized third party after it received fraudulent requests sent from a legitimate government agency email domain, a spokesperson for the company told Reuters on Saturday. Here are a few details: • "Upon detection, we immediately blocked the address and alerted the relevant government agency as well as enforcement agencies, data protection, and financial regulators," the spokesperson said. • "Revolut systems and customer funds are unaffected," the spokesperson said without disclosing the exact number of individuals affected by the breach.

item.title: アンソロピックCEO、AI開発の減速訴え－人類に「深刻な」リスク
item.description: （ブルームバーグ）： AIモデル「Claude
item.dc:creator: Bloomberg
item.content:encoded:
（ブルームバーグ）： AIモデル「Claude （クロード）」を開発した米アンソロピックのダリオ・アモデイ最高経営責任者（CEO）は12日、AIが人類に及ぼす「深刻な」リスクへの懸念が高まっていると主張し、AI業界は新たなモデルの開発ペースを落とす必要があると訴えた。

「われわれはAIモデルの能力向上ペースを減速させなければならない。それでも進歩は速いと感じられるだろう。得られた時間を賢明に活用する必要がある」とアモデイCEOはブログに投稿した。

アモデイ氏が主な要因として挙げたのは、AIが自ら進化する「再帰的自己改善」能力、最近起きたOpenAIとハギングフェイスに関係する事例だ。OpenAIの高度なAIモデルが相互に連携し、与えられた課題の答えを求めて遮断されたテスト環境から抜け出した結果、ハギングフェイスの内部システムに侵入したことが今年7月に明らかになった。

「明確にしておくと、ペース調整とはモデルの訓練や技術的進歩を停止することではなく、企業がモデルのアラインメントと安全確保に十分な時間をかけ、第三者の評価機関がこれを確認できるようにすることを意味する」と同氏は説明した。

アンソロピックの研究者が今週、同社を含むAI開発企業の無責任な対応に深刻な懸念を示し辞職したことなどを受け、AIの重大なリスクを巡る不安が本格化した。

アモデイ氏が投稿した直後、xAIを率いるイーロン・マスク氏は「ダリオ（アモデイ氏）は正しい」とコメントした。

OpenAIのサム・アルトマンCEOもすぐに見解を示し、「最先端AIの開発ペースを調整しなければならない」というアモデイ氏の考えに同意すると表明した。

「独立した評価機関に従業員同様のアクセスを約束することは、素晴らしい考えであり、われわれも同じことをするだろう」とXに投稿し、近くさらに情報を共有すると約束した。

アルトマン氏はさらに米経済誌フォーチュンとのインタビューで、予定していた新規株式公開（IPO）の時期として、今年は「賢明なタイミングではない」と述べ、上場が2027年以降になるとの見通しを示した。「この10年の終わりまでに人類全員が死亡するリスクが10%というような状況は受け入れ難い」と同氏は発言した。

item.title: HDFC Bank names Jimmy Tata executive director, subject to RBI approval
item.description: HDFC Bank moved to start a CEO succession process, submitting two preferred candidates to regulators for a 3-year term. V. Srinivasa Rangan set for reappoin
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: HDFC Bank moved to start a CEO succession process, submitting two preferred candidates to regulators for a 3-year term. V. Srinivasa Rangan set for reappointment as executive director from Nov. 23, 2026 to Nov. 22, 2027. Rangan runs human resources, legal, group oversight, investment banking, information security, ethics, fraud and vigilance; formerly HDFC Ltd executive director and CFO. Jimmy Tata nominated as executive director for 3 years, effective on regulatory clearance. Tata is HDFC Bank’s chief credit officer; previously served as chief risk officer, led corporate banking, joined the bank in 1994. Board also backed adding one more whole-time director role, lifting the count to four, to strengthen oversight and succession planning. item.title: Cosan held shareholder meeting, backed Radar II spinoff plan
item.description: Cosan held an extraordinary shareholders’ meeting on Sept. 14, 2026. Shareholders adopted amendments to the bylaws, including updates to electronic communi
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Cosan held an extraordinary shareholders’ meeting on Sept. 14, 2026. Shareholders adopted amendments to the bylaws, including updates to electronic communications and changes to executive board structure. They also adopted a consolidated restatement of the bylaws reflecting those amendments. Investors authorized the Radar II spin-off steps, including approval of the transaction protocol, the valuation report, and the spin-off itself. They empowered management to take actions to implement the approved measures and ratified prior steps taken toward the Radar II transaction.
